name: relay
tagline: An analog signal-sorting mystery for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
description: A decommissioned coastal relay station. Old analog transmissions come in and you work shifts sorting them into the right archive channels, while the story hidden in the static pieces itself together one fragment at a time. Free to start, with a single unlock for the full Archive.

name: NotchGames
tagline: Six neon arcade games you pull out of your MacBook's notch.
description: A macOS menu bar app with six neon arcade games you pull out of the notch: pong, air hockey, brick breaker, snake, a runner and a shooting gallery. Move the pointer up, play a round, push it back and get on with your day. No Dock icon and no special permissions.
